exact_quantifiers.theorem_3_1: For any null distribution P, confidence bounds satisfying Eq. 6 at delta in (0,1), and any alpha in (0,1), the conditional false-rejection probability is at most alpha with probability at least 1-delta over D0.
exact_quantifiers.theorem_3_3: Under a fixed alternative Xt iid~Q != P for all t>=1, fixed D0, sufficiently small k, and Delta_k>0, Algorithm 1 has asymptotic power one; as k->0 its expected stopping time is O(Delta_0^-2 log(1/(alpha Delta_0)) + Delta_0^-2).
exact_quantifiers.figure_4: At severity 5 over all 15 ImageNet-C corruptions and n in {100,500,4000}, conditional CTM outperforms standard CTM for reasonable n>=500; standard/conditional median rejection-time ratios tend to exceed 1 for larger-shift Blur and Weather groups.
